_about: Example clips, NOT real people: synthetic voices and drawn placeholders, so the whole show can be rehearsed before the real videos arrive. Each clip covers a different case: English or French, landscape video, portrait (phone) video, or voice note. French clips get English subtitles. `text` is what the voice says; `en` is the subtitle when it differs.

cues.text: When a candidate walks in late without a word, the jury has already formed an opinion.
If you know you will be late, call before the interview starts.
When you arrive, greet everyone, apologise once, and move on.
And never blame the traffic.
Quand un membre du jury vous coupe, ne vous arrêtez pas.
cues.en: When a jury member cuts you off, don’t stop.

cues.text: Restez calme, et demandez poliment : est-ce que je peux finir ma phrase ?
cues.en: Stay calm, and ask politely: may I finish my sentence?

cues.text: Trente secondes suffisent.
Un bon jury écoute. Un bon candidat garde le fil.
cues.en: A good jury listens. A good candidate keeps the thread.

cues.text: Hardworking, motivated, team player. I hear those words ten times a day.
Without proof, they mean nothing.
Tell me a real situation, what you did, and the result.
With a number, if you can.
In my panel interview, a juror called my answer weak.
I wanted to argue. Instead, I asked which part worried him.
Then I answered that exact point, with facts.
Criticism is often a question in disguise.
Une première impression, ce n'est pas une preuve.
cues.en: A first impression is not evidence.

cues.text: Dans notre jury, chacun note seul, avec une grille, avant de discuter.
cues.en: On our jury, everyone scores alone, with a score sheet, before we discuss.

cues.text: On juge le travail, pas la cravate.
cues.en: We judge the work, not the tie.

cues.text: When a candidate has no questions, I wonder if they really want the job.
Ask what success looks like after six months.
Ask what problem the team has today.
An interview is a conversation that goes both ways.
Trois minutes pour décider, c'est trop court.
cues.en: Three minutes to decide is too short.

cues.text: Avant de dire non, relisez le dossier du candidat.
cues.en: Before you say no, read the candidate’s file again.

cues.text: Parfois, la meilleure preuve est à la page trois.
cues.en: Sometimes the best evidence is on page three.
